verdict.rationale: Only one concrete, narrow mention of pricing structure exists — the Global Employment & Equity Compensation Solutions page states services are offered 'all on a fixed-fee basis' — but there is no firm-wide statement of rate structures, general AFA policy, or billing practices. Missing for 10: firm-wide fee transparency page, published rate card or AFA menu, discussion of billing practices beyond one niche service line, independent corroboration of pricing claims.
